text:
Olivia: Anyone up for a 'Model Karaoke' open mic this Friday? Idea: we each pick a song and a model persona to perform as. :microphone::robot_face:
Raj: 100% in. I'm doing 'Bohemian Rhapsody' as a Hallucination-prone ensemble :joy:
Bea: haha love it. Can we have categories? 'Overconfident Llama' 'Whisper-lounge' 'Quantized-Indie'
Tom: I'll do 'Tiny Desk Concert' but as `tiny-quant` AKA the whisper-sad-bard :guitar:
Nina: Poll idea: drop options and people react with :one: :two: etc? Also venue: kitchen or the rooftop?
Olivia: Poll: 1) Kitchen 2) Rooftop 3) Zoom. React below. Also song suggestions open. I'll start with prompts for inspiration:
Olivia: ```
Prompt: "You are a caffeinated GPT singing 'Africa' like it's release notes."
Style: overexcited, bullet-point choruses, PR-author tone.
```
Jamal: Yes to kitchen. Votes: :one: from me. Also I'm bringing a fake fog machine.
Raj: :two: rooftop! Also demo idea: personify a model as a 90s talk show host.
Bea: Voted :one: but can be convinced for rooftop. Also pairing idea: pair songs with inference quirks. Example: chorus repeats = auto-regressive echo :laughing:
Olivia: Nice. Quick logistics: 6pm Friday. Bring snacks. Also tiny challenge: sing as 'the model that unexpectedly returns code blocks'. Winner gets a sticker pack.
Tom: I'll prep a 30s bit: `if (you.sing) { return chorus.repeat(3); }` :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
event-bot: Reminder: All-company noise policy: events after 9pm need sign-off. Noted for 6pm OK.
Nina: Ooh sticker pack hype. Also open mic sign-up sheet? I'll throw a simple Google form in #random tomorrow.
Olivia: Cool. Tag me if you want to co-host. @Bea @Raj @Tom
Raj: :thumbsup: count me in. Also, can we have a 'prompt jam' corner where people riff on absurd system messages?
Jamal: I vote for a prompt jam. Will demo 'The Apologetic Model'—starts every verse with 'sorry, but...'
Bea: Thread ending poll results in 24h. For now: Kitchen leads. :kitchen: :microphone:
